rules.title: Immutable Full Commit SHA Pinning for Workflows and Actions
rules.summary: Reusable workflows and composite actions must be referenced using a full 40-character Git commit SHA. Branch names (main, v1) and mutable tags are strictly prohibited as workflow references.
deprecated_patterns: uses: lawchai/lawchai-standards/.github/workflows/ci-react-ts.yml@main
uses: lawchai/lawchai-standards/.github/workflows/ci-react-ts.yml@v1
uses: lawchai/lawchai-standards/.github/actions/verification-factory@main
reference reusable workflows by branch name

provenance.rationale: Prevents supply-chain mutation and ensures callers bind to audited, immutable workflow revisions.
provenance.historical_context: Replaced earlier mutable branch references across LawChai consumer repositories.

rules.title: Per-PR Structured Scope Contract Declaration
rules.summary: Every implementation pull request must add or modify .github/lawchai-scope.yml on its own branch declaring allowed_paths. Inherited scope metadata fails CI to prevent silent reuse of prior PR authorizations.
deprecated_patterns: inherited scope metadata from previous PR
skip .github/lawchai-scope.yml update
reusing scope declaration without file change

provenance.rationale: Enforces strict authorization boundaries per pull request.
provenance.historical_context: Established to prevent out-of-scope code changes across portfolio dispatches.

rules.title: Non-Zero Deterministic Test Execution Guard
rules.summary: Every implementation dispatch must execute configured tests and prove non-zero executed test count. Test-file presence alone or zero-count test execution fails verification.
deprecated_patterns: test file presence alone constitutes verification
zero tests executed treated as pass
executed_nonzero: false marked as READY_PR

provenance.rationale: Guarantees test suites actually execute assertions rather than reporting false green CI.
provenance.historical_context: Replaced early posture where test file presence was incorrectly treated as passing test execution.

rules.title: Verified Closure Deployment Identity Contract
rules.summary: Verified Closure compares a live deployment identity document (/version) with the expected commit SHA. Deployment command success alone is not verified deployment.
deprecated_patterns: deployment command exit 0 implies verified deployment
assume deployment success without version document
deploy step completion is sufficient evidence

provenance.rationale: Ensures deployed artifacts are verifiably matching expected source commits in production.
provenance.historical_context: Introduced to eliminate false deployment confirmations.

rules.title: Human-Only Control Boundary for Portfolio Trust Root
rules.summary: lawchai-standards is the portfolio-wide trust root. Dispatching autonomous agents directly without human authorization and manual review is prohibited.
deprecated_patterns: dispatch autonomous agent directly against trust root without authorization

provenance.rationale: Protects portfolio-wide reusable CI and standards integrity.
provenance.historical_context: Core trust boundary of LawChai standards infrastructure.

rules.title: Mandatory Terminal State and Schema-Driven Handoff
rules.summary: Every task must reach exactly one terminal state: READY_PR, [BLOCKED] draft PR, or UNCHANGED_FAILURE, with schema-driven handoff report generated.
deprecated_patterns: complete dispatch without terminal report
leaving uncommitted modified branch without PR
terminal state READY without handoff validation

provenance.rationale: Ensures reproducible task completion and explicit handoff evidence.
provenance.historical_context: Standardized across all LawChai dispatch brief templates.

rules.title: Governed Premium UI Standard Hierarchy and Accessibility
rules.summary: UI modifications must preserve visual hierarchy, product-specific identity, 44px controls, 3px focus outlines, 320/390px responsive viewports, and semantic state colors.
deprecated_patterns: generic dark card styling without product identity
recolouring warning or error semantic states to brand accent
controls under 44px touch target

provenance.rationale: Prevents generic UI convergence and enforces accessibility standards across web apps.

rules.title: Mutable Branch Workflow References (Superseded)
rules.summary: Referencing central workflows via branch names like @main or @v1.
deprecated_patterns: uses: lawchai/lawchai-standards/.github/workflows/ci-react-ts.yml@main

provenance.rationale: Superseded because branch references allowed unverified workflow updates.
provenance.historical_context: Early practice before immutable SHA pinning was mandated across portfolio.

rules.title: Inherited Scope Metadata Reuse (Superseded)
rules.summary: Reusing .github/lawchai-scope.yml from prior merged PRs without re-authorizing in the active PR diff.
deprecated_patterns: inherited scope metadata from previous PR

provenance.rationale: Superseded because inherited scope bypasses per-PR file modification checks.
provenance.historical_context: Superseded when per-PR scope verification was introduced.

rules.title: Test File Presence as Verification Pass (Superseded)
rules.summary: Assuming verification passes merely because test files exist in the repository without running them.
deprecated_patterns: test file presence alone constitutes verification

provenance.rationale: Superseded because unexecuted tests provided false verification confidence.

rules.title: Deployment Exit Code Zero Pass (Superseded)
rules.summary: Treating deploy step completion as proof of verified deployment.
deprecated_patterns: deployment command exit 0 implies verified deployment

provenance.rationale: Superseded because deployment scripts could succeed without publishing the correct commit SHA.
provenance.historical_context: Superseded by Verified Closure live version document verification.

rules.title: Informal PR Completion Without Terminal Handoff (Superseded)
rules.summary: Concluding tasks with informal verbal summaries without schema-driven handoff reports.
deprecated_patterns: complete dispatch without terminal report

provenance.rationale: Superseded to guarantee structured evidence and clear exact next actions.

rules.title: Portfolio UI Audit Snapshot (2026-08-06)
rules.summary: Historical record of the UI audit executed on 2026-08-06 documenting branch states and verification debt.

provenance.rationale: Preserves historical audit log without treating audit-time draft PR states as active policy.
provenance.historical_context: Created during portfolio-wide UI audit pass.
